Name: Harzelora's Elliott Portrait for Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic
Author: Toddyalpes
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Hello everyone! I’ve always loved the Elliott portrait art created by Harzerola and published by Hanilemon. I’ve also always loved the "Seasonal Outfits" mods—especially Poltergeister's work.

So, for my own game, I decided to edit the art to combine Harzerola's portrait style with Poltergeister's outfits.

With permission from both artists, I’m sharing this here for anyone interested.

Note: This currently covers the portraits only. I plan to adapt the sprites soon.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Simply unzip the file into your Mods folder and overwrite the existing files when prompted.

Alternatively, you can manually replace the portraits inside the original Elliott folder within the "Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic" mod.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/color]

My heartfelt thanks go to Poltergeister, Harzelora, and Hanilemon for creating such fantastic art and allowing me to edit and share it.
